newsitem.title: INDIA: India's GSFC postpones $80 mln Euroissue.
newsitem.headline: India's GSFC postpones $80 mln Euroissue.

text.p: India's Gujarat State Fertiliser Company (GSFC) has postponed the launch of its $80 million issue of global depositary recepits (GDRs) due to poor market conditions, an investment banking source said on Wednesday.
"The company is also considering alternative financing methodologies including a convertible bond," the investment banker said.
He said GSFC had decided to delay its issue due to a sharp fall in its share price. GSFC shares have fallen more than 40 percent in the last four months.
Investment bankers said the issue -- which had been scheduled for the third quarter of 1996 -- was unlikely to be launched this year.
